tools.name: list_filings
tools.description: Use when someone asks for a company's recent SEC filings, such as its latest 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K, by ticker or CIK. Works for any company in the SEC's ticker list. Returns up to 20 filings from the company's recent EDGAR window, each with a filing id, form type, dates, accession number and original SE

tools.name: read_filing_section
tools.description: Use when someone asks what a filing says in a section, wants its section index, or needs a sourced excerpt. A metric row label with a section returns a table row, its definition or footnote, and the SEC page. A phrase with a section or attachment filename returns one matching sentence and its printe

tools.name: filing_facts
tools.description: Use when someone asks for the reported numbers in one filing, such as revenue, net income or total assets. Returns XBRL facts tagged to that filing's accession, for the API's ten supported concepts: up to 200 reported values with units and periods. It does not return all periods for a company and it

tools.name: compare_filing
tools.description: Use when someone asks what changed between a filing and the one before it, such as this year's 10-K against last year's. Compares the filing with the preceding available reporting period of the same company and form. Returns full sentence-change counts and bounded examples for up to eight sections,

tools.name: read_section_across_companies
tools.description: Use when someone asks what several companies say in the same section of their latest filing of one form, such as the risk factors in the latest 10-K of each company in a list. Takes up to 25 tickers or CIKs, a form and a section id. Returns, per company, a status (ok, unknown_ticker, no_filing, no_s

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_filing_section" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when someone asks what a filing says in one section, such as risk factors or the business description, or wants the list of sections in a filing. The filing id is one that list_filings returns. Without a section it returns the section index with no text. With a section it returns the text, at mo" → after: "Use when someone asks what a filing says in a section, wants its section index, or needs a sourced excerpt. A metric row label with a section returns a table row, its definition or footnote, and the SEC page. A phrase with a section or attachment filename returns one matching sentence and its printe"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
